_comment: Cross-language contract for RENDERING a shortcode attr value.
the real `parse_attrs` grammar and requires the value back out as `raw`.
Together: whatever the editor writes into `{image=…}` on an accepted asset
completion is provably parseable by the build. This file is the gate — do
not add a 'keep in sync with attrs.rs' comment instead; add a vector.

vectors.note: ASCII bareword — unquoted, the common case
`/` and `.` are bareword chars, so an absolute path stays unquoted
CJK is NOT bareword — must be quoted or parse_attrs rejects the item
a space would end the value; quoting makes it one token
`"` IS escapable — read_quoted's backslash arm takes any char
backslash must double or it would escape the next char
a `}` inside quotes does not close the block (parse_attrs_spanned doc)
the author's display-attrs suffix survives an accept; `|` forces quoting
CJK path plus suffix — the corpus shape
